bio: From the team behind Oncle Lee, this restaurant with subdued lighting from red lanterns focuses on grilled dishes (kăo is Mandarin for "grill"): lamb skewers with cumin and shishito peppers, spicy or grilled beef tataki, five-spice duck, sea bream with Sichuan sauce, octopus with lap cheong. Served with wok-fried vegetables and glazed with soy sauce and maple syrup, the grilled Cornish hen is a particular treat. Generous, fragrant cuisine perfect for sharing in this lively atmosphere.
